conditions.text: The applicant is an estate resident seeking an NIC amendment.
The applicant is not an estate resident and seeks an NIC amendment.

content.text: The non-estate route also requires the Divisional Secretary's countersignature on the application certified through the Grama Niladhari.

For an estate resident, forward the amendment application through the Estate Superintendent. The amended-card issue fee is LKR 500 and can be paid through the certifying officer. Normal registered-post delivery adds LKR 120; that postal charge is outside the recorded base fee.

For a non-estate resident, forward the amendment application through the Grama Niladhari for the area of residence. The amended-card issue fee is LKR 500 and can be paid through the certifying officer. Normal registered-post delivery adds LKR 120; that postal charge is outside the recorded base fee.

items.text: After certification through the Grama Niladhari, the non-estate route requires the Divisional Secretary’s countersignature on that application. This is another step in the same route, not an alternative to Grama Niladhari certification. No separate countersignature fee is specified in this snapshot; that does not establish that it is free.
